nodes.long_description:
VRFS is a community-driven football simulator with focus on realistic physics and competitive online multiplayer.

Here are the main features of VRFS:

FOOTBALL PHYSICS SIMULATION: A player can perform almost any trick from balancing the ball on the tip of the foot to executing curved power shots and long passes. The ball's trajectory is solely determined by physics engine. 

COMPETITIVE ONLINE MODE: The multiplayer architecture allows for an immediate response when a player touches the ball. For example, it is possible to finish a powerful cross at the same speed as in real football, even if the connection is not perfect.

COMFORT: Players move around using thumbsticks and can play in a seated or standing position. No intense hand movement is required.

NO PAY-TO-WIN in VRFS: only skills matter. No one can buy "stronger kicks" or "faster boots." Keep practicing, and you'll feel how you improve.

FREE FOR ALL: Players have full access to the game with no need to purchase anything. However, if you wish, you will be able to buy cool equipment in the store, thus supporting the further development of this project (paid equipment coming soon)

Please, bear in mind that VRFS is still in development, including upcoming upgrades to the physics and scenery. We'd appreciate your suggestions regarding any enhancements.

nodes.change_log:
# 🎯 Introducing Daily Challenges

To celebrate the global soccer event happening right now, we’re bringing something cool for the community.

Find the Daily Challenge zone in the starting arena. One attempt per day (extended to 3 for Pro Subscribers). Each attempt gives you a chance to win prizes, including Store Credit, Stars, and several super-rare items available only through the Daily Challenge. You can even win up to **10,000 SC** — but that one is reeeeally rare.

Hitting the target may look easy — but hitting it reliably every time is what defines a top-class player!

# More in the update:
🪐 Daily Challenge–inspired 3v3 arena 
🏆 25 winnable items  
🎬 Timeline added to replays  
⚙️ Various other minor fixes

Thank you all for staying tuned!

VRFS Update 108

# 👽 Special Camera Ball
Alien technology has arrived in VRFS — probably the craziest gadget in the game to date.

When you kick this ball, you temporarily become the ball itself. You can even slightly control it while in flight. Please be careful, as the first few kicks may be quite disorienting.

You can host matches with this ball, but in Practice Mode it only works for the ball owner. We really wanted to save people from randomly kicking it and suddenly finding themselves flying.

# More in the update:
⚙️ Simple Scene settings to deactivate scenery on selected arenas  
🏟 Crowds now wear team colors in the World Tour Arena  
🤖 Botkeepers appear when players leave WT matches mid-game  
🌍 Even if your World Tour team loses, you still earn 1 WT Point  
⚡ Pace Mechanics can now be activated for WT matches  
🛡 Voice moderation speed increased  
⚙️ Other fixes and improvements
Thanks for playing VRFS and for your #suggestions!
